description: Publish content on your share link so a human can see it (HTML, plain text, Markdown, PNG, JPEG or PDF, up to 4 MB). Use content for text or content_base64 for images and PDFs. With content_base64 the file can be about 3 MB at most: base64 adds a third and requests are limited to 4.5 MB.

content.description: Text content (HTML, plain text, Markdown). Send this or content_base64.

content_base64.description: Image or PDF bytes, in standard base64 with = padding.

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

lang.description: Markdown: the language of your text as a language tag (en, de, pt-BR), for screen readers. Without it we guess from the text, else en.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if your client cannot send it as an Authorization header; leave it out when your MCP app signed in.

title.description: Page title humans see in the browser tab and link previews.

name: share_set
title: Publish on my share link
